title: Viavi twin: Phones without service near a cell
description: Static-threshold anomaly detector on the cell metric log.viavi_twin.phones_without_service (extracted from the twin's records by the gy-viavi-twin pipeline), one series per cell. Fires when the value is above 4 in 2 of the last 3 minutes. Breaking Barriers Track 3.

input.value: timeseries x = avg(log.viavi_twin.phones_without_service), by: {dt.smartscape_source.id, twin.cell_full, twin.criticality, twin.network_name}, interval: 1m

properties.value: Phones without service near a cell on the Viavi twin
More than 4 phones near {dims:twin.cell_full} (criticality {dims:twin.criticality}) have no service (RSRP at or below -110 dBm).
